title: All frontends repeated comparison
notes: 3 repetitions per case, 2 s warmup and 10 s measurement per run. Native desktop display at 60 Hz and 1× scaling.

context.renderer: Qt Graphs LineSeries / Qt Quick scene graph (C++)
context.measurement_stage: QXYSeries::replace(QList<QPointF>) + scalar index conversion into an Indexed8 QImage with the shared colour table (RGB frames wrap the packet bytes) + synchronous QML image-provider submission; palette expansion and texture upload happen on the scene-graph render thread and are excluded; GPU work excluded
